title: Live: French astronaut Sophie Adenot set for launch to International Space Station
summary: NASA and SpaceX are set to launch four astronauts to the International Space Station on Friday, replacing a crew that left early in the first medical evacuation in the station's history. Sophie Adenot will be only the second Frenchwoman to travel into space. Follow our blog for the latest updates and watch the launch live from 11am Paris time (GMT+1).
